About me

AI-focused B.Tech undergraduate exploring Data Science, Machine Learning, Agentic AI, and AI research.

Background

I did my schooling from Kendriya Vidyalaya No.6, Jaipur, then right afterwards in 2023, I started my Btech at Poornima University.

In initial days of my college, I saw a 3Blue1Brown video on how a Neural Network can differentiate between 0-9 digits, that inspired me for years to come.

I have also Interned at ASD Cybersecurity as an AI & Automation intern where I gained hands-on experience building AI-driven applications.

What I work on

I work on building intelligent systems that can learn from data, understand complex information, and automate real-world tasks. My work spans ai agents, machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and software development.

I’m particularly interested in how AI systems can move beyond making predictions to reasoning, using tools, and adapting to different situations. I enjoy experimenting, failing, and coming up with creative ideas that are turned into practical applications.

How I approach projects

Whenever im building a project:
1) Initially i evaluate the techstack that might be required
2) Learn the Underlying concepts
3) Start solving the problem following a Top-Down approach starting with breaking down it in broad areas
Core Ethos : Find Simple solutions to Complicated problems, Be Curious, Be Creative
